issue_context.title: `atob` should ignore spaces
issue_context.body:
### Version

17.8.0

### Platform

MacOS 12.2

### Subsystem

global / buffer

### What steps will reproduce the bug?

_No response_

### How often does it reproduce? Is there a required condition?

_No response_

### What is the expected behavior?

```js
atob(' ') === ''
```

### What do you see instead?

```js
atob(' ') // => DOMException [InvalidCharacterError]: Invalid character
```

### Additional information

https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/webappapis.html#dom-atob
https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#forgiving-base64-decode
comments: `atob` is a legacy API anyway, you're better off using `Buffer.from(str, 'base64').toString('latin1')` if you need the same exact kind of output (or leave it as a Buffer, which is almost always a better option when working with binary data).
